title: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement, Entrepreneurship and Innovation
outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to plan, organize, and execute a project or new venture with the goal of bringing new products and service to the market.
Demonstrate a fundamental comprehension of business opportunity evaluation, from the perspective of a prospective investor.
Compile and interpret for basic financial statements used by business owners to attract potential investors to finance start-ups and/or expansion of the business.

Effectively communicate, interpersonally and collaboratively, with basic computer proficiency, including the use of word processing, presentation, and spreadsheet software packages, as well as a basic facility with the internet and other research tools.

notes: The course tables on catalog pages 73-75 appear shifted relative to their section headings. The table printed directly under the 'Certificate of Achievement, Entrepreneurship and Innovation' heading lists ACCT 1, ACCT 4, ACCT 68, BADM 1, BADM 2, ENTR 1 (Total Units Required 18.0). That looks like the Accounting certificate's table, since the Accounting section above prints no table.

The table recorded here (BADM 5, CBIS 1, ENTR 1, ENTR 2, ENTR 3, ENTR 4; Total Units Required 19.0) is printed under the 'Certificate of Achievement, Warehousing and Logistics, Level 1' heading, between its outcomes lead-in and its outcomes. It matches the closed list and the entrepreneurship course titles exactly, so I read it as this certificate's requirements. The Warehousing Level 1 section then prints its own WARE 52/54/55 table (9.0 units).

A reviewer should confirm which table belongs to this award. If the table printed under the heading is meant instead, the total would be 18 and ACCT 1, ACCT 4, ACCT 68, BADM 1 and BADM 2 would be catalog additions.
The program outcomes are the four bullets at the top of page 74, which follow the Entrepreneurship and Innovation section. No careers are named in this section.
